units.source_text: “什么肮脏……也许真的是从京都来的。

en.t: How filthy... maybe they really did come from Kyoto.

units.source_text: 说不定是住在旅馆里，在找房子的时候把钱花光了，

en.t: Perhaps they were staying at an inn and spent all their money while looking for a house,

units.source_text: 然后想起利用每天四处走动时发现的空房，

en.t: and then thought of using the vacant houses they had found while wandering around every day,
and started doing this kind of business, I suppose.
